cues: Now compare two right angled triangles.
In triangle A B C, B C is the distance B travelled: c t.
In triangle A D C, A D is the radius of A's wavelet: also c t.
They share the side A C, and both have a right angle, at B and at D, because a wavefront is always perpendicular to its ray.
